message: I have this friend who turns every weather forecast into a mini-crisis. Last summer, when they mentioned a heat wave, I swear I could hear the sirens in the background. Meanwhile, I just grabbed a pitcher of lemonade and a good book. It’s funny how we all handle storms differently, isn’t it? I like to think a little calm can go a long way—what's your go-to strategy for weathering the next storm? ☔
